item.title: No Shows: Hardware Wildlife Management Area's wagon rides wrap up early due to lack of snow & elk
item.description: The unusually warm winter is impacting wildlife migration. For the Hardware Wildlife Management Area, the lack of snow is keeping hundreds of elk at bay. In turn, the annual wagon rides to see the herd are wrapping up a week earlier than planned.

item.title: Southern Utah farm invites residents to come see baby animals
item.description: As winter progresses into Spring, many farms and livestock businesses are welcoming new life into their herds with an abundance of newborn animals. One Southern Utah farm is inviting residents to come see and learn how they take care of the young animals and help them grow.

item.title: Eagle Mountain man will go to trial for 11 felony charges related to sexual assault
item.description: A 19-year-old from Eagle Mountain is set to go to trial for 11 felony charges related to sexual assaults across two separate cases.

item.title: Low snowpack puts focus on conservation for Great Salt Lake
item.description: Conservation is going to play a critical role in reviving the Great Salt Lake to healthier water levels, according to local experts. Unfortunately, this has proven to be no easy task, especially during a Winter season that's produced record low snowpack.

item.title: Silicon Slopes Summit brings innovators and tech investors to Salt Lake City
item.description: This week, hundreds are attending the Silicon Slopes Summit held in the heart of Salt Lake City to discuss technology development, innovation, and advancing the industry in Utah.

item.title: Utah families make big impact in newborn screening for creatine deficiency
item.description: February is Rare Disease month, and two Utah families are leading the way in newborn screening for Creatine Deficiency.

item.title: 'Constitutional court' becomes three-judge panel for challenges against the state, advances in Utah legislature
item.description: A new version of Utah's proposed "Constitutional Court" passed the Utah House on Wednesday and is moving swiftly through the legislature, slated to be heard in a Senate committee on Thursday.

item.title: 'High School Musical' director visits East High for the film's 20th anniversary
item.description: It's been two decades since the Disney classic High School Musical captivated kids across the world, and as part of the 20-year celebration today, director Kenny Ortega visited East High School.

item.title: Pine Valley Recreation Area shares reconstruction updates following devastating fire and floods
item.description: Months after the devastating Forsyth fire and subsequent flooding, Pine Valley Recreation Area is sharing updates on its rebuilding process.

item.title: Utah family seeks change to homicide cases, after daughter dies years after being shot
item.description: After their daughter died from complications from being shot years earlier, a Utah family is asking the legislature to enact a bill that would allow murder prosecution in cases where the victim initially survived.
